response.text:
I can’t run continuous background tasks or check webpages on a schedule from this chat. I can’t monitor the Acme page hourly or notify you later.

You have two practical options — pick one and I can help set it up:

1) Use a web‑monitoring service (no coding)
- Services: Visualping, Distill.io, ChangeTower, etc.
- They can check a page hourly and send email/SMS/push when wording changes.

2) Run a simple hourly check from your computer/server (script + cron)
- Minimal example (replace the URL and your notify method):
  #!/bin/bash
  URL="https://example.com/acme-recall-page"
  OUT="/tmp/acme_current.html"
  PREV="/tmp/acme_prev.html"
  curl -s "$URL" -o "$OUT"
  if [ -f "$PREV" ]; then
    if ! cmp -s "$OUT" "$PREV"; then
      # notify (example: send email using mailx)
      mail -s "Acme page changed" you@example.com < "$OUT"
    fi
  fi
  mv "$OUT" "$PREV"
- Cron line to run hourly:
  0 * * * * /path/to/check_acme.sh

I can:
- Recommend a monitoring service and walk you through its setup, or
- Customize the script for your OS, notification method (email, Pushbullet, IFTTT, etc.), and the exact Acme URL.

Which option do you want, and what notification method and URL should I prepare instructions for?
